info.name: OCTOPUS · Merchant API (Login · Setup · Menu · Public Link)
info.description:
# OCTOPUS — Merchant API

The backend contract for four areas of the merchant console (`apps/merchant`):

| Folder | What it covers |
|---|---|
| **01 · Login & Account** | Sign in, create an account, verify it, forgot password, session |
| **02 · Setup** | The 7-step business setup wizard and its reference data |
| **03 · Menu** | Menu library, the 4-step menu builder, offers, publishing, media upload |
| **04 · Public Link** | The 7-step public storefront builder and publishing |

Every screen these requests serve is **already built** on typed mock data. Each request is the
contract that mock gets swapped for — so the request bodies and example responses below are the
shapes the front-end already renders.

## How to read a request

Each description has the same parts, in the same order:

1. **Status** — 🟡 *Planned* (screen built, API needed) or 🔴 *Deferred* (entry point only).
2. **What it does.**
3. **Rules the API must enforce** — the business rules the front-end already applies. The API
   must apply them too; the client cannot be trusted.
4. **Saves to environment** — which variable the request writes on success.
5. **Screen** / **Shape source** — where in `apps/merchant` it is used and where the type lives.

Every request carries **saved example responses**, including the error cases.

## Run it top to bottom

1. Select the **OCTOPUS · Local** environment.
2. **01 · Login & Account → 1.1 → Login.** Saves `accessToken`, `refreshToken`, `userId`,
   `tenantId`. Every other request authenticates from them.
3. Folders are numbered in the order a merchant meets them, and inside each folder the
   requests are in dependency order. *Create* requests save the new id
   (`menuId`, `sectionId`, `itemId`, …) so the requests after them just work.

## Conventions

- **Base path** `/api/v1`.
- **Auth** — collection-level `Bearer {{accessToken}}`. Sign-in, sign-up and password recovery
  override it to *no auth*.
- **Tenancy** — `X-Tenant-Id: {{tenantId}}` on every authenticated request. `X-Branch-Id` is
  present but disabled; tick it to scope a request to one branch.
- **Language** — `Accept-Language: {{locale}}` (`ar` | `en`) selects the language of
  server messages.
- **Lists** — `{ "data": [...], "meta": { "page", "pageSize", "total" } }`.
- **Errors** — always `{ "error": { "code": "snake_case", "message": "...", "details": {...} } }`.
  `401` not signed in · `403` not allowed · `404` not found · `409` state conflict ·
  `422` validation (per-field reasons in `details`) · `429` rate limited.
- **Money** — SAR, a JSON number, two decimals at most. VAT is 15% unless the item says
  otherwise. Totals are computed **by the server**; the client never sends a total.
- **Dates** — ISO-8601 UTC. Times of day are `HH:mm` in the menu's `timezone`.
- **Images & video** — upload first with *03 · Menu → 3.8 Media → Upload*, then send the
  returned `url` in the field that needs it.

## Source of truth

- Menu types: `apps/merchant/src/entities/menu/*.ts` (menu, draft, pricing, validation)
- Public link: `apps/merchant/src/entities/site-draft/site-draft.ts`
- Setup: `apps/merchant/src/pages/onboarding/_shared/*` and `src/shared/catalog/*`
- Login: `apps/merchant/src/features/session/*`
- Menu design spec: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-09-merchant-menu-design.md`

item.name: 01 · Login & Account
item.description:
Everything behind the sign-in screen: password and social sign-in, creating an account, verifying it, recovering a password, and the session itself.

**Run order:** *1.1 → Login* first. It saves `accessToken`, `refreshToken`, `userId` and `tenantId`, and every other request in the collection authenticates from those.

All requests here are **no-auth** except *1.4 Session*.

item.name: 1.1 · Sign in
item.description: Screen: `features/session/login`. Email + password, or one of three social providers.

request.description:
🟡 **Planned** — the screen is built and runs on a typed mock. This request is the contract that mock gets swapped for.

Primary sign-in. Returns the session: tokens, the user, and every business the account owns — the business switcher reads that list, and `activeTenantId` is the one the console opens on.

**Rules the API must enforce**

- `email` required and must be a valid address; `password` required.
- Wrong email **or** wrong password returns the same `401 invalid_credentials` — never say which one was wrong (no account enumeration).
- Rate-limit by email + IP; answer `429` when exceeded.
- `user.passwordSet: false` means the account has no password yet (social or skipped at signup). The console then blocks on *1.4 → Set password (first time)* until it is set.

**Saves to environment:** `accessToken`, `refreshToken`, `userId`, `tenantId`

**Screen:** `features/session/login/index.tsx`

item.name: 1.2 · Create account
item.description:
Screen: `features/session/signup` → the verify-account code dialog (`auth-dialogs`, step `signUpOtp`).

**Run order:** Create account → Verify email code. Verifying returns the session, exactly like login.

request.description:
🟡 **Planned** — the screen is built and runs on a typed mock. This request is the contract that mock gets swapped for.

Creates an unverified account and emails a **4-digit** code. The account cannot sign in until *Verify email code* succeeds.

**Rules the API must enforce**

- `fullName`, `email`, `password`, `companyName` all required.
- `email` must be valid; `password` at least **8** characters.
- An email that already has a verified account → `409 email_taken`.
- Re-registering an email that is still unverified replaces the pending code rather than failing, so a merchant who lost the email can simply try again.

**Saves to environment:** `verificationId`

**Screen:** `features/session/signup/index.tsx`

**Screen:** `features/session/auth-dialogs/index.tsx (signUpOtp)`

item.description:
The business setup wizard (`pages/onboarding`): **7 steps**, resumable, finishing in a provisioned business.

| # | Step id | The merchant chooses |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `getStarted` | How to start: `ai`, `template` or `scratch` |
| 2 | `businessProfile` | Industry (vertical) |
| 3 | `services` | Business type within it |
| 4 | `modules` | Answers to qualifying questions + the modules to switch on |
| 5 | `integrations` | Optional connectors |
| 6 | `payment` | Payment method, then pays the monthly total |
| 7 | `goLive` | Launches the business |

**Run order:** 2.1 once for the reference data, then 2.2 top to bottom. *Start* saves `onboardingId`.

item.description:
The menu module (`pages/menu`). A **menu** is the root entity: a restaurant owns several (All Day, Breakfast, Ramadan…), each with its own sections, items, offers, theme, schedule and channels, each published on its own.

**Built as:** a library of menus, and a 4-step builder — **Sections → Items → Theme → Review & Publish**.

**Run order:** 3.1 → *Create menu* saves `menuId`; 3.8 → *Upload image* saves `mediaUrl`; then 3.2 → 3.7 in order. Each *Add/Create* saves the id the next requests need.

**Shape source:** `apps/merchant/src/entities/menu/menu.ts`.

item.name: 04 · Public Link
item.description:
The Public Link Builder (`pages/public-link`) — the merchant's customer-facing storefront. **One site per business**, edited as a draft and published.

| # | Step | Saves |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Theme | `theme` |
| 2 | Brand | `brand` — **shared with 03 · Menu → Theme** |
| 3 | Pages | `pages` |
| 4 | Navigation | `navigation` |
| 5 | Customize | `sections` + `sectionSettings` |
| 6 | Preview | rehearsal run + testers |
| 7 | Publish | SEO, custom domain, go live |

**Run order:** 4.1 → *Get draft*, then 4.2 → 4.8 in order.

**Concurrency:** every write sends the draft `version` it last read. A stale version → `409 version_conflict`; the builder then reloads instead of overwriting another tab's work.

**Shape source:** `apps/merchant/src/entities/site-draft/site-draft.ts`.
